title: Hitamo umwirondoro w'igerageza
notSecurity: Guhitamo uruhare ni igerageza gusa, si umutekano.
productionNote: Porogaramu nyayo ikenera uburyo nyabwo bwo kwinjira (PIN, igikumwe cyangwa intambwe nyinshi). Ntibiri muri iri gerageza.

empty.title: Nta mwirondoro w'umukozi w'igerageza uri mu makuru
empty.description: Amakuru y'igerageza nta mwirondoro w'umujyanama w'ubuzima cyangwa umugenzuzi afite. Ni ikosa ry'uwakoze porogaramu.

scope.title: Emeza aho ukorera
scope.readOnly: Aho ukorera hava ku mwirondoro wawe w'igerageza; ntihashobora guhindurirwa hano.
scope.testHook: Igerageza: injira mu kigo kitari mu byo washinzwe
scope.unknownPersona: Uyu mwirondoro w'igerageza ntuboneka. Subira inyuma uhitemo undi.

denied.label: Ntiwemerewe
denied.title: Iki kigo ntikiri mu byo washinzwe
denied.message: Umwirondoro wawe w'igerageza ntushinzwe iki kigo, bityo kwinjira byanzwe. Igerageza ryanditswe.
